subject: general
question: GCKH is related to EAIF in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JFNK is related to HDLI. To which of the given options is MIQN related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• **Letter Shift:** Each letter is shifted backward by 2 positions.

Applying the logic to the given pairs:

**GCKH is related to EAIF**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e59faf3eb6ec322f3c8a09b9b84379936ca19b10160c10db134111ea93e8e5b.png] 

**JFNK is related to HDLI**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4527e08857cd1899d68e19a691ac1d323c357e655ee23bd4a75c652309becba.png] 

Applying the logic to MIQN:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c40b391c049767ebd1ce118c19157a55dcaf5720d8b90460072a87099a967d69.png] 

Following this logic, MIQN is related to **KGOL**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
